messages:
maria (pm): heads up — protodeploy scheduled tonight during quiet window 21:30 UTC. planning a 5% staged rollout to prod. release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/2.14.3 :spiral_note_pad:

ashwin (eng): quick summary: runtime hotfix + kv-cache tweak + updated kernel selection. pinned model serving runtime to v2.14.3 in the deploy plan. no schema changes.

carlos (eng-infra): infra looks green. increased GPU pool soft-limit by +1 for the window. autoscaler cooldown set to 300s.

jamie (sre): what are explicit rollback criteria? need thresholds for tail latency, 5xx, and memory OOM spikes. also confirm change window and contact list.

maria (pm): suggested rollback triggers: tail p99 > 2x baseline for >10m, 5xx rate >1% sustained for 5m, or KV cache OOMs on >2 hosts. change window 21:30–22:30 UTC. oncall: @sre-oncall.

ashwin (eng): added the exact checks to deploy config:
```
checks:
  - p99_latency_multiplier: 2.0
  - error_rate_pct: 1.0
  - consecutive_oom_hosts: 2
rollback_action: pin_version:v2.14.2
```
Also added a canary health eval that compares generation latency distribution.

deploy-bot: protodeploy scheduled by maria at 21:30 UTC. plan: canary=5% -> monitor 15m -> ramp to 25% if healthy -> 100% after 2h. CI: green.

maria (pm): please call GO/NO-GO. will wait 10m for final checks. :eyes:

ashwin (eng): GO from eng infra side. verified pin step and rollback thunk. :thumbsup:

carlos (eng-infra): GO from infra. no maintenance windows conflicting.

jamie (sre): NO-GO until I confirm synthetics run. running smoke now (synth-suite/quick).

deploy-bot: synth run started: synth-suite/quick (id: s-7741).

jamie (sre): synth results: baseline comparisons — slight p95 blip in eu-west (+18%) but within tolerance. still running full pass (5m).

sre-oncall: monitoring dashboards set: links -> https://dashboards/internal/prod-rollouts/2.14.3. alert policies attached. will escalate to infra if >1.5x p99 or >0.5% 5xx.

jamie (sre): full synth done. all ok except ephemeral 5xx spike on a single host during a backend flake. not repeating. I'm OK with GO but will keep a 30m tight watch.

maria (pm): OK — GO at 21:30. initiating deploy. :shipit:

deploy-bot: starting canary rollout -> 5% traffic (tag: protodeploy-1746004321).

deploy-bot: canary deployed. now monitoring health checks (15m window).

jamie (sre): seeing 5xx rate in eu-west at 0.9% trending up. p99 increased by 1.7x baseline. still below hard cutoff but trending. putting a temporary HOLD for investigation.

maria (pm): holding — do not proceed to 25% until cleared. ashwin, can you triage?

ashwin (eng): checking logs and stack traces. looks like a new kv-cache eviction race on older hosts; mitigating patch ready to push. can we pin traffic away from eu-west while we fix?

carlos (eng-infra): we can attenuate region traffic via routing rule, shifting eu-west from 5%->1.5% while retaining canary elsewhere. applying now: `rbacctl route set protodeploy-1746004321 eu-west=1.5%`

deploy-bot: routing rule applied. eu-west reduced to 1.5%. global canary now ~4%.

jamie (sre): after attenuation, error rate dropped to 0.35% and p99 back to 1.1x baseline.

maria (pm): decision time — two options: 1) continue ramp after fix, 2) rollback now. vote?

ashwin (eng): I can push a fast fix and cut a tiny patch (non-invasive) within ~15m, then resume. prefers quick patch and continue.

jamie (sre): I'm +1 for patch & resume as long as we keep canary capped at 5% and monitor 30m post-patch. If anything crosses rollback thresholds, we rollback immediately.

maria (pm): consensus = patch & hold cap. ashwin, proceed when ready. I'll update release notes and notify support.

ashwin (eng): pushing patch now. patch deploy plan: kill and replace faulty cache loop on affected hosts, then restart runtime. nothing changes client-side.

deploy-bot: patch deployment started to canary hosts.

deploy-bot: patch applied to 3 canary hosts. health check report: all green.

jamie (sre): monitoring 12m after patch: errors at 0.12%, p99 1.02x. no OOMs. Safe to proceed with progressive ramp to 25% after 15m more observation.

maria (pm): great. proceed to 25% in 15m. please keep this thread updated.

deploy-bot: ramping to 25% now.

deploy-bot: traffic shift complete. canary success criteria met. scheduled next ramp to 100% in 2 hours.

maria (pm): closing note — pinned previous version in rollback action stays as v2.14.2. full release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/2.14.3/notes. thanks everyone for fast triage. :raised_hands:

ashwin (eng): will follow up with a postmortem on kv-cache race and add an automated synthetic covering it.

jamie (sre): adding a regression alert for the new pattern.

sre-oncall: I'll keep 30m extra oncall and hand off at 01:00 UTC.

maria (pm): thread archived after 22:30 UTC unless any rollback. good job team.
